name: Mitsurugi Himeko
source:
She is the daughter of the president of "Mitsurugi Foods". She attends the Royal Academy through the recommendation of the government of Japan. She is a strong-willed person who left her home country to live alone abroad.

Since she's also Japanese, she approaches the protagonist under the pretense that becoming friends is an inevitability. For the first time in her life, she develops a crush. She can be quite tsun towards the protagonist.

With her tenacious attitude and Yamato spirit, she is the school's favorite mood-maker. She gets mad when people make fun of her hair and her family's ramen noodle business. She may look smug but she can be a bit of a dork. She is always honest and positive, she's someone you just can't hate.
